facts.text: Model 44 is the syringe pump class the GTK UI instantiates
The GTK UI opens the pump on /dev/ttyUSB0
The serial line is 9600 baud with two stop bits
A command is written as text followed by a carriage return
A reply begins with LF, its text ends at CR, and the frame ends with a digit and one of the prompt characters
The prompts are ':' stopped, '>' running, '<' reverse, '/' paused, '*' stopped and '^' wait for a dispense trigger
The pump caches the status named by the prompt of the last reply
set_diameter sends 'DIA <value>' and its docstring names the syringe diameter in millimetres
get_diameter sends 'DIA', get_target_volume sends 'TGT' and get_volume_accum sends 'DEL'
get_flow_rate sends 'RAT' and splits the reply into a value and a unit token; the token 'ml/mn' means mL/min
set_flow_rate sends 'RAT <value> <range token>' and the range token for mL/min is 'MM'
start sends 'RUN', stop sends 'STP', clear_volume_accum sends 'CLD' and reverse sends 'DIR REV'
set_direction sends 'DIR INF' for forward and 'DIR REF' for reverse
set_target_volume sends 'TGT <value>'; clear_target sends 'TGT 0'
set_pump_mode sends 'MOD PMP', set_volume_mode sends 'MOD VOL', and get_mode sends 'MOD' and lowercases the reply
get_version sends 'VER'
_format_float rejects a value above 1e6 and truncates its formatted form to six characters; it is an encoder guard and an encoder truncation, not a range of the pump
The UI's range table gives the mL/min range the volume unit mL
The UI displays the Model 44 target volume in mL
The upstream setup.py describes the package as a Python interface to Harvard Apparatus OEM syringe pump modules

measures.description: Volume accumulated by the pump (DEL), in mL for the mL/min range
measures.name: accumulated_volume

operator_required.name: diameter
operator_required.reason: the syringe diameter depends on the syringe fitted; no text of the clone states a diameter range, and _format_float only truncates the encoded value (harvardpump/pump.py:171-173), so the site supplies the diameter envelope

operator_required.name: flow_rate
operator_required.reason: the clone sends any formatted value with one of four range tokens and states no numeric range (harvardpump/pump.py:227-238); the site supplies the flow-rate envelope of the installed syringe and tubing

operator_required.name: target_volume
operator_required.reason: the target volume depends on the syringe and no text of the clone states a volume range; the UI's spin-button maximum is a UI default, not a device bound (harvardpump_ui:536-537), so the site supplies the volume envelope

safe_state.description: pump stopped with STP; no new motion until a RUN
